improvements_backlog.estimated_impact: gates 4→12 (trajectory covers all gates at Crazyflie-trackable speed)
improvements_backlog.rationale: Min-snap polynomial peaks 16.84 m/s but Crazyflie max ~5 m/s. Clamping polynomial velocities to 5 m/s would extend trajectory time from 14.3s to ~28s+, allowing drone to follow full trajectory through all 12 gates without needing fallback mode. Eliminates the 34m target jump at the trajectory→fallback transition.
When sim_time > trajectory.total_time, the target jumps 34m from trajectory end (x=52) to gate-2 (x=18). A ramp/blend over 2-3s would prevent the violent maneuvering that eventually causes the crash.

improvements_backlog.estimated_impact: better trajectory following at varying speeds
improvements_backlog.rationale: 0.3s fixed lookahead is conservative for slow segments and may overshoot on fast. Proportional to local curvature/speed would be better.

improvements_backlog.estimated_impact: reduce tumble risk during gate approach
improvements_backlog.rationale: gate_fallback uses min(dist*2, 5.0) which commands high speed until very close. A gentler decel profile would prevent overshoot and tumble.

diagnostic.root_cause: Architectural: min-snap trajectory peaks 16.84 m/s (measured) vs Crazyflie max horizontal accel 6.87 m/s². Closest-point tracking + 5 m/s clamp addresses the command-speed issue, but the trajectory is planned for 14.3s at 10 m/s. With 5 m/s clamp, drone only covers ~40% of trajectory before sim_time exceeds total_time, triggering a 34m target jump to fallback.
